raw.details:
Welcome to the Namo Bharat – 30-Hour National Hackathon 2026 - by Sanskriti University!

A national hackathon where software development ideas take shape through innovation, teamwork, and technical problem-solving.

General Queries & Support:

Join our official WhatsApp group for queries, updates here: https://chat.whatsapp.com/Kr9UVBnUMyjEkiU0y6qDMx

About the Opportunity:

Namo Bharat – 30-Hour National Hackathon 2026 is an offline hackathon by Sanskriti University, focused on Software Development and Conferences. Designed for team participation, it invites participants to develop and present innovative solutions through an online coding challenge format and an offline hackathon experience.

Participants can showcase problem-solving, creative thinking, technical skills, teamwork and collaboration, and presentation skills through PowerPoint. The opportunity connects software development with a collaborative, conference-oriented setting where teams can bring their ideas forward and demonstrate their solutions.

Competition Structure:

The structure for this online coding challenge is as follows:

  • PPT Submission – Namo Bharat Hackathon: Submit your team’s idea through a PPT for Namo Bharat – 30-Hour Hackathon 2026. Showcase the problem you aim to solve, your proposed solution, key features, innovation, and technology or tech stack. The submitted PPT will be evaluated through the Unstop platform. This stage runs from 27 September 2026 to 11 October 2026.
  • Offline Round: Present your idea through a PPT for a chance to be among the Top 100 shortlisted teams. Selected teams will be invited to Sanskriti University for the 30-hour offline hackathon on 17–18 October 2026, where they will build, innovate, and showcase their solutions

Rewards and Prizes:

Rewards & prize details (as provided):

  • 1st price: ₹11,000 and a certificate, recognising the leading team and its achievement in the hackathon.
  • 2nd: ₹6,000 and a certificate, celebrating a strong team performance and solution.
  • 3rd: ₹4,000 and a certificate, honouring an impressive contribution to the competition.

Bring your team, sharpen your solution, and take the next step with Namo Bharat – 30-Hour National Hackathon 2026 by Sanskriti University.
